name: orca-web-patches
description: Version-aware browser compatibility patches for Orca Web.

scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run test && npm run build && node --check dist/orca-web-patches.user.js && npm run check:public
scripts.check:syntax: for f in src/*.js src/patches/*.js scripts/*.mjs tests/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
